description: This Java class 'Result' provides a generic response structure for HTTP responses within the org.eclipse.hono.service.management package. It encapsulates HTTP status, payload, and optional cache directives, and includes utility methods for creating responses and converting them to event bus messages.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: A generic class representing an HTTP response with status, payload, and optional cache directives, capable of generating event bus messages and providing utility methods.

methods.name: getCacheDirective
methods.description: Returns the optional cache directive associated with the response.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the payload of the response.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Indicates whether the response status represents an error based on HttpUtils.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a Result instance with a specified status and a supplier for the response type.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Generates an EventBusMessage response based on the request, the response status, and a payload mapper.

methods.name: toStringHelper
methods.description: Returns a MoreObjects.ToStringHelper pre-filled with instance fields for debugging.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object's toString method to provide a string representation of the instance.
